item.title: WEIRDLY PLACED 4000 CLOSING POST 8/15
item.content:encoded:
Well, you all deserve a round of applause. PeppersGhost deserves three, and the rest of our top five (six!) deserves two. And then one more, for running a good, clean contest.

Looking at the results, I'm legitimately honored to have been able to run this contest. Y'all do damn fine work, here.

Over the next couple of days, we'll be putting things in their slots, prettying things up. Entrants should watch their PM inboxes for some updates. This is going to be a messy process, so please bear with us.

And I'd like to thank everyone who participated, commented, voted, or even just read the works for their role in making this the highlight of my career on the wiki, and truly a contest for the record books. Here's to another 10 years!

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Jesus fuck, this was amazing. I admit I haven't read all the entries, because attention span, but I know some crazy good work was produced here. I'm most impressed by the fact that some people submitted a successful 4000 entry as their first article ever (though it might have been unbearable if "4000 was a first SCP" became the default response to "it sucks because it's my first"; 1000 is plenty to live up to already!)

♪ I wish you a merry 4k, and a great Series 5. ♪

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I wish to extend upon this, and marvel upon the breadth of creativity that we've seen in the entrants.

We have SCPs about the history of the Foundation, SCPs about historical events, SCPs about physical manifestations of historical events, SCPs about the recording and access to history, SCPs about time travel, SCPs expanding on existing Foundation lore, and some weird shit to close it all out.

There's alien monsters, Death, dinosaurs, dreams, faeries, heaven, a hole, the Library of Alexandria, the Olympics, 'Murica, Republicans, Santa, sex goddesses, a bunch of different origins for the Foundation, and dozens of other bizarre and unique concepts.

To the Foundation, to history, to the future, and to the authors and readers, congratulations.

well done, everyone. here's to a thousand million more years of scp. ♥
